content:
Earlier this month, OpenAI released its first GPT-6 model paired with Astra. The GPT-6 series has now added new members, with the official debut of the GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna models.

GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now available

According to the release notes of the ChatGPT desktop application, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna consume fewer tokens than their counterpart GPT-5.6 model.

GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are gradually rolling out on Codex and ChatGPT Work, with lower token pricing than its predecessor GPT-5.6 version. Sol is suited for complex coding and intelligent agent workflows, while Luna is suited for focused, high-throughput tasks. Both models will be progressively made available to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users. Free and Go users can use Luna on the desktop application. Actual availability depends on deployment progress and workspace settings; Enterprise administrators must enable the new models. Within ChatGPT, both models are available only on Work and Codex, not on Chat.

It is worth noting that there is no GPT-6 Terra model. It is expected that OpenAI is phasing out mid-size models, keeping only three: Terra (small), Sol (large), and Astra (extra-large).

The following is the official announcement from OpenAI:

Although the toughest and most important tasks still require Astra's full depth, different jobs have different scales, rhythms and budgets. Precisely because of this, we are expanding the GPT-6 series with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. GPT-6 Astra pioneered a new generation of intelligence, and these models push the frontier of cost-effectiveness to bring the benefits of that intelligence to a wider audience. We trained GPT-6 Sol and Luna using the same methodology as GPT-6 Astra, bringing Astra's top performance in specialised work, factual accuracy, coding, computer use and alignment into faster, more affordable models.

The company described its two latest models as outperforming the GPT-5.6 version in performance, while being cheaper than Astra (and the GPT-5.6 version it replaced). For instance, the GPT-6 versions of Sol and Luna are priced 50% lower than the GPT-5.6 version.

In terms of coding, OpenAI had the following to say about its new models:
